title: The Window a ShieldCare Instalment Reads the Trading Record Over
content:
The window over which the trading record on the account is read, for the purpose of pricing an
instalment on a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan, turns on the customer's store credit account
held under Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts: whether that account stands active, and
whether a statement has closed on it inside the last 3 months.

| What the account shows | The window the trading record is read over |
| --- | --- |
| a statement has closed on the customer's store credit account inside the last 3 months, and that account stands active | the trading record is read over the last 12 months |
| that account stands active, and no statement has closed on it inside the last 3 months | the trading record is read over the last 6 months |
| every other profile | the trading record is read over the last 3 months |

### Points of judgement

An account that does not stand active reaches neither of the first two rows, and the window is the
last 3 months whether or not statements have closed on it. Where the account does stand active, a
statement closing inside the last 3 months is what lengthens the window from 6 months to 12.

### Cases on hypothetical records

| Store credit account | Statement closed inside the last 3 months | Window read |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no account on the profile | not applicable | 3 months |
| suspended | yes | 3 months |
| active | no | 6 months |
| active | yes | 12 months |
